thread:
Maria (pm-release): Heads-up: planning a dedicated GPU pool autoscale change tomorrow 16:00 UTC. Aim: reduce min nodes from 6 -> 3 and enable burst nodes up to 18 (p4d + p4de mix). Need deploy owner + smoke checks. Can someone take? :eyes:
Keegan (eng-platform): I can own the rollout and monitor. ETA to be in the deploy window and keep an eye on queues.
Ravi (infra): Quick question — are we changing instance types in the same deploy or is that separate?
Maria (pm-release): Single deploy. We'll update autoscaling policy + add p4de into the pool. We tested the AMI in staging.
Olga (ml-infra): Confirmed AMI uses driver 545. Godbolt image matched load test. One note: kv-cache memory tweak needed for p4de. I'll post a short patch.
Tess (sre): I'll be on call for the smoke and metrics. What are the SLOs we should watch? CPU/GPU util, queue depth, p99 latency?
Keegan (eng-platform): SLOs: p99 inference latency < 750ms on hosted-dedicated routes, queue depth < 30 pending requests per shard, GPU mem util < 98% for sustained 60s.
Jon (oncall): I'll run the smoke script after deploy and check health endpoints. Where's the runbook?
Keegan (eng-platform): Runbook snippet pasted below. Keep it handy in deploy channel.
Keegan (eng-platform): ```
# smoke-checks
1) curl -sS https://dedicated-infer.company/internal/health | jq .ok == true
2) run load generator for 60s: ./tools/quick-load --concurrency 8 --seq-len 512
3) verify KV cache hit rate > 60% and GPU mem < 95% in the last 2m
4) confirm autoscale controller reports desired >= min_nodes and <= max_nodes
```
Maria (pm-release): Rollout plan: canary on 10% traffic to updated pool for 15m, then 50% for 20m, then full. Canary routing handled by routing service; Keegan will flip weights.
Ravi (infra): Rollback plan: revert autoscale policy and remove p4de from pool, re-add old min=6. Should be <10m to enact. Deploy-bot will run the toggle.
deploy-bot: Scheduled maintenance: dedicated-gpu-pool-autoscale at 2025-10-22T16:00:00Z. Notifying relevant oncall.
Olga (ml-infra): Patch for kv-cache and driver check: PR #4391. Recommend merging now so Keegan can deploy cleanly.
Keegan (eng-platform): I'll merge PR after a quick CI run and tag the deploy. Posting diff and CI link in #eng-releases shortly.
Tess (sre): One more: alert thresholds to watch during canary — autoscale controller error rate > 1% for 5m, routing 5xx rate > 0.5%, p99 latency regression > +150ms. If any fire, rollback to prev policy.
Jon (oncall): I'll be on-call and available at the window. Ping me if canary fails, I'll trigger rollback.
Maria (pm-release): Thanks all. Keegan, can you confirm by EOD that CI + PR merged so we don't block? :thumbsup:
Keegan (eng-platform): Yep — CI green, PR merged. Deploy tagged as "dedicated-autoscale-2025-10-22". Will start the canary at 16:00 UTC tomorrow.
Tess (sre): After canary, I'll post smoke results here.
Keegan (eng-platform): Canary started. routing weight 10% -> done. Monitoring dashboards: https://grafana.company/d/dedicated-gpu-pool
Tess (sre): Smoke: health endpoints ok, p99 680ms, queue depth 12, GPU mem 88%, KV hit 63%. No anomalies for 15m.
Keegan (eng-platform): Moving to 50% now.
Tess (sre): 50% ok for 20m. p99 700ms, small blips but within SLOs.
Keegan (eng-platform): Full rollout complete. Updating infra docs.
Maria (pm-release): Great job — thanks everyone. Closing the loop: min nodes now 3, max 18 with p4de added. Will follow up with cost impact in analytics next week. :tada:
